subject: Request: vendor onboarding — support checklist & escalation matrix
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: procurement@orbis-systems.com
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 03 Apr 2027 09:02:00 -0400
Subject: Request: vendor onboarding — support checklist & escalation matrix

Hi Luis / Orbis procurement team,

Thanks for moving quickly here. Procurement at Redwood is collecting the operational artifacts we need to complete vendor setup and issue the PO. Can you please provide the following items in a single packet (or point us to a shared folder)?

- Support & escalation matrix (names, roles, primary/secondary/on-call)
- SLA targets (availability, MTTR targets by priority) and any credits or remediation language
- Standard support SLAs (response & resolution windows) and definitions for priority levels 
- Onboarding form (vendor contact, billing remit, tax info) and any required order-of-operation for PO issuance
- Preferred invoicing cadence and purchase order reference requirements
- Any required security/compliance evidence (SOC2, penetration test report) or a link to where we can pull them
- Runbook/runway availability for critical incidents (do you have an on-call SRE contact and a documented escalation playbook?)

We need this to close procurement and enable the Dedicated deployment. Target timeline: procurement wants to ingest these artifacts by EOB Wednesday (2027-04-07) so we can get the PO out that week. If you have a template you prefer, that’s fine — we just need the escalation contact details and explicit SLAs called out.

Thanks — I’ve looped Lauren (contracts) and Marissa (legal & CS) to help coordinate any redlines.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Senior Procurement Manager, Redwood Inference
E: evelyn.hart@redwood.ai | M: +1 (415) 555-0142

Attachment: none (requesting files)
From: Luis Ortega <luis.ortega@orbis-systems.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@orbis-systems.com
Date: Fri, 03 Apr 2027 14:18:22 -0400
Subject: Re: Request: vendor onboarding — support checklist & escalation matrix

Hi Evelyn (and team),

Appreciate the clear list. Please find attached our standard onboarding packet: Orbis_SLA_Template_v2.pdf and the vendor_onboarding_form.xlsx. Summary highlights below — full details in the attached SLA doc.

- Uptime target: 99.9% (monthly) for our hosted control plane; infrastructure neighbors vary by deployment model — we include quantized expectations per region in the PDF.
- Priority definitions:
  P1 (Service down / critical business impact) — 30 minute acknowledgment, 4 hour mitigation plan
  P2 (Degraded service / major impact) — 1 hour acknowledgment, 24 hour remediation plan
  P3 (Minor issue / feature request) — 4 business hour acknowledgment
- Primary support channel: support@orbis-systems.com (mon-fri, 06:00-18:00 PT)
- 24/7 on-call escalation: oncall@orbis-systems.com (P1 escalation route)
- Primary on-call: Diego Valdez, SRE Lead — +1 (617) 555-0105 (listed in attachment)
- Billing & PO: Please send PO to billing@orbis-systems.com with reference to the Redwood PO number; invoice cadence: Net30 by default (can be changed per contract)
- Security evidence: SOC2 Type II report available on request; we can grant access to the secure share once NDA is signed (link in PDF)

If you want a redline-friendly editable version of the SLA, the attached Word/PDF can be annotated. Happy to hop on a 30-minute call early next week to walk through anything.

Regards,
Luis Ortega
Head of Partnerships, Orbis Systems
L: luis.ortega@orbis-systems.com | T: +1 (617) 555-0123

Attachments: Orbis_SLA_Template_v2.pdf (26 KB), vendor_onboarding_form.xlsx (12 KB)
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Luis Ortega <luis.ortega@orbis-systems.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 04 Apr 2027 10:30:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Request: vendor onboarding — support checklist & escalation matrix

Thanks, Luis — that’s helpful and I see the attachments. A couple quick clarifications from procurement/ops before we finalize: 

1) For P1 acknowledgments you list 30 minutes — can you confirm that this is a guaranteed SLA for Dedicated customers (we expect this to be part of the contract)?
2) For 24/7 on-call we need a named escalation second contact and a phone-based escalation channel (not just an email oncall). Can you please add the night SRE contact and confirm an escalation phone bridge number?
3) On the vendor_onboarding_form.xlsx, the billing remit fields request a W-9 or equivalent — confirm whether Orbis requires a Redwood PO number on the invoice and if you accept e-invoicing.

If you can send an updated SLA page with the P1 phone escalation and the secondary on-call name, that will let legal & procurement proceed. Also, please mark which items in your SOC2 share are acceptable for procurement ingestion (summary vs full report).

Thanks — we’re aiming to have the PO issued once the final SLAs are confirmed.

Best,
Evelyn
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Luis Ortega <luis.ortega@orbis-systems.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 04 Apr 2027 12:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Request: vendor onboarding — support checklist & escalation matrix

Evelyn / Luis — quick internal ask from Legal/CS: please include the following in your next update so we can avoid a separate SOW review cycle:

- Explicit P1 phone escalation number (24/7) and a named second on-call (for midnight PT incidents)
- Confirmation that the 30-minute P1 acknowledgement is contractual for Dedicated deployments (not best-effort) and an example credit formula if missed
- Confirmation whether Orbis provides runbooks/playbooks for high-severity events (we want an opt-in to receive runbook access on PO execution)

Luis, if you can provide the updated SLA pages and indicate where the SOC2 summary lives (or provide a secure link), Marissa will take the redline. I can then give procurement the green light to issue the PO.

Thanks all — copying Lauren as she’ll map billing fields in the PO.

—Marissa
Director, Customer Success & Legal Liaison, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0199
